unit: Geometry · Chapter XI. Areas and volumes

stages.headline: The area of a parallelogram is a side times the height drawn to it: S = a · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The area of a parallelogram is a side times the height drawn to it: S = a · h.

stages.headline: Proof: cut the triangle off the left and move it to the right; we get a rectangle with the same area.
stages.headlineEnglish: Proof: cut the triangle off the left and move it to the right; we get a rectangle with the same area.

stages.headline: Since h = b sin α, also S = ab sin α; e.g. a = 6, b = 10, α = 30° ⇒ S = 30.
stages.headlineEnglish: Since h = b sin α, also S = ab sin α; e.g. a = 6, b = 10, α = 30° ⇒ S = 30.
